user.title: Configure IBEX BG Integration
user.description:
Set up your IBEX BG price monitoring integration. This integration fetches day-ahead electricity prices from the Bulgarian Independent Bulgarian Energy Exchange (IBEX).

Configure when to fetch data and retry settings for reliable price monitoring.

error.name_too_long: Instance name must be 50 characters or less

error.no_days_selected: At least one day must be selected
